items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 90:1
items.html: The particular Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya and Yechida, which are clothed in the Sefirot Keter, Hochma, Bina and ZON of every Partzuf, emerge by means of couplings by striking in the way of the refining of Malchut; and therefore they stand one above the other. However, the four Partzufim AB, SAG, MA and BON emerge by means of the ascent of the Tabur to the Peh, where it acquired a new coarseness and descended to its place, as above in Item 168. Therefore the Chazeh of the upper one becomes the Peh of the lower one, and they are found standing one below the other. (Inner Observation, Chapter 13, Item 1)
